info.name: NHPR & ABDM Complete API Collection
info.description: Complete Postman Collection containing all Web and ABDM Gateway APIs for NHPR Doctor/Nurse Registration, HFR Facility Registry, ABHA Enrollment & Verifier, HIP Care Context Linking, HIU Consent Manager, and Gateway Webhook Callbacks.
